title: Glowing Ore Outlines
description: Glowing and outlined ores in vanilla with no mods or Optifine required!
body:
![A banner/title with the text "Vanilla Glowing Ores" and "By r0k3tkutt3r" in Minecraft Title format](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aba9931fd3c318dfa359cf59c8815e29ca7171f.png)
Adds glowing ores on vanilla for versions 26.1 and beyond.

**No dependencies needed**, just place it at the top of your resourcepacks. No compatibility (at the moment) with any modded ores or other resourcepacks.

[![Kinetic Hosting banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e5234712d32562be999b307b425ca6286f4b8e_0.webp)](https://billing.kinetichosting.com/aff.php?aff=1447)
